final_message:
I fixed `LRUCache.get` in `src/lru.py`, but I haven't run it or any tests.

The bug was that `get` returned the value without marking the key as recently used. After a `get`, that key could still be the next one evicted by `put`, so later lookups of an evicted key returned `None`. `get` now moves the key to the end of the usage order before returning the value.

I only had the code to go on, so this is the one cause I found. If users are seeing a different kind of wrong result, tell me the input and I'll look again.
